subject: PR #109 landed green via squash 7bcedad; native-material fixed; env-1 seat released
result: PR #109 (Preserve native source, material scope and execution continuity) merged squash into main as 7bcedad; all CI green on the exact merged tip (caw-native, verify, secret-conformance, product-ground, pre-local-build). Lane fix/seat-scope-finish-20261005 in env-1/workcell rebased the 31 branch commits onto main, then fixed four real defects found between local gates and CI: (1) cargo fmt drift in workcell-runtime/lib.rs; (2) three clippy denials in instance_publication.rs (format-in-format-args, type-complexity, redundant st_ino cast); (3) st_dev compared with a target-dependent cast — i32 on macOS, u64 on Linux — replaced with lossless i128::from widening, found only by Linux clippy; (4) the four namespace-executing kernel cases could never pass on hosted ubuntu-24.04: evidence from the run artifacts showed unshare succeeds but the identity-mapping write is denied (apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1, EACCES at /proc/self/setgroups, checkpoint ending at setgroups-open; two observation cases died as SpawnFailed EACCES at spawn, two execution cases refused with typed namespace-phase failures). Per the PR contract that hosted namespace refusal is required evidence and never a skip, the cases now branch on the real outcome: capable kernels take the unchanged positive path; policy refusals are asserted by their exact recorded contract (checkpoint stage or typed failure, executed=false, zero material effect, members unchanged). Also fixed two load-flaky test races: three poll guards raised to the file 8-10s convention, and the durable inherited-guard note is now read only once complete (parent raced the child create-before-write; this same family had flaked on main CI on Sep 28). Local verification: full scripts/verify.sh green twice under central-clearing admission (clearing afe4bc27153b497cea7a6e3fcb27fe45960b43d293dfa88d36dc30c0bfe080ce, now quiescent, evidence retained in its T), plus Linux cross-check and cross-clippy for the cfg(linux) paths CI would hit. CI iterations used: 2 of 3 (iter 1 exposed the st_dev Linux clippy denial, iter 2 reached and exposed the hosted namespace refusals). Seat released; branch label fix/seat-scope-finish-20261005 remains in git per seat law; primary checkout untouched on main.
